tagline: Google's AI assistant bundled with Gemini Advanced and Google AI Pro.
verdictSummary: A personal chat client over model APIs you pay for directly is a real, cheap build. What can't be replicated is the actual subscription: frontier model access from Google specifically, plus deep integration with Gmail, Docs, and Drive that only Google's own product can offer.
coreLoopDIY: A chat client that talks to the Gemini API directly (and optionally other providers), with document upload, conversation history, and full-text search.
whatYouLose: native integration with Gmail, Docs, and Drive
a unified flat subscription instead of metered per-token billing
continuous model updates bundled into one product
whyPeopleStillPay: People pay for model access and being placed natively inside the Google apps they already use — not because a chat interface itself is hard to build.
notes: Completes the frontier-model comparison set alongside ChatGPT and Claude — a useful reference point for how the same structural 'no' reasoning applies across vendors.
prompt:
Build a personal chat client over model APIs you control: a streaming reply pane, a model picker (Gemini's API directly, and optionally others), and conversation history stored with full-text search. Support uploading PDFs and images to models that accept them. Add system-prompt presets as plain files you can select per conversation. Let any conversation export to Markdown. Show a running cost estimate from each API response's usage data, since metered per-token billing can land above or below the flat subscription price depending on how much you actually chat.

Do not build Gmail, Docs, or Drive integration, or a mobile app — those need real platform access this project doesn't have, and they're a meaningful part of what the subscription buys for someone already living in Google's apps.

faq.q: Can I import my Gemini conversation history?
faq.a: Google's data export tools include your Gemini activity, and that export gives you a record of past conversations, but it doesn't import cleanly into a live, continuing thread in a different tool.

faq.q: Will it work on my phone?
faq.a: As a responsive web page, yes, if hosted somewhere reachable. There's no native app and no integration with your phone's Google apps.

faq.q: What does it cost to run?
faq.a: Hosting is a few dollars a month; API usage is metered per token and can land above or below the flat subscription price depending on how much you actually chat — the built-in cost tracker shows you which.

faq.q: What's the one thing that doesn't survive the rebuild?
faq.a: Being where your Google account already lives. Gemini can read context from your Gmail and Drive directly; a personal chat client only ever sees what you explicitly upload to it.
